samples.question: This picture shows a signal depot on a plain white background. Exactly two things are drawn, and they sit far apart at opposite corners. One is a single signal plate: a grey rectangle with a dark grey frame, holding one vertical stack of dark round lamps. The other is a block of exactly four crates, each drawn as one filled coloured rectangle: one red, one amber, one green and one blue, in any arrangement. Each crate holds a row of dark upright bars. The signal plate may hold any number of lamps from 2 to 5, and the four crates hold 2, 3, 4 and 5 bars in some order, so exactly one crate holds as many bars as the plate holds lamps. Call that crate the twin crate. The bars are wider when a crate holds fewer of them, so no crate is bigger or inkier than another. What colour is the twin crate? Answer with exactly one of: red, amber, green, blue.
